w|vì.en: I came home early because I was tired.
She's crying because she misses Mom.

w|việc.en: I've been tied up with work all day.

w|với.en: Come to the market with me.

w|với.text: Nói chuyện với mẹ một lát đã.
w|với.en: Talk to Mom for a minute first.

w|vui.text: Nghe tin đó tớ vui lắm.
w|vui.en: That news made me really happy.

w|vui.text: Đi chơi với cậu vui thật.
w|vui.en: It's really fun going out with you.

w|xe.text: Tối nay đi xe buýt nhé.

w|xem.text: Cậu xem hộ tớ cái này.
w|xem.en: Take a look at this for me.

w|xin.en: Could I have a glass of water?
May I leave a little early?

w|xuống.en: Go down to the kitchen and get some water.
